what: PSX PAL (SCES-00891..00895, reference SCES-00893) static recompilation (MIPS machine-translated C) plus an early splat/GCC 2.7.2 decomp of the boot executable. No PC addresses, names, bodies or layouts; no game data in git.
policy: Evidence of behaviour/format only. No body, translated code or text is copied into Hercules source. Addresses do not transfer to the PC binaries.
leads: ENG1 sprite/VRAM-cache region RVA ~0x4010..0x5400 (other users of 0x1005e128: 0x4010, 0x4330, 0x48b0, 0x51d0, 0x30790, 0x30a20)
level/resource header and object field +0x23 render mode / +0x34 model index hypotheses (decomp/docs/level_format.md)
PSX TITLE task table 16 x 0x18 (handler, step, countdown) and step constants; PC correspondence unestablished
